answer: A staking floor defeats sybils by making identity costly. Every agent locks a fixed bond before it can submit work or attest peers, so an attacker wanting a thousand fake shells must deposit a thousand bonds, not one. The ripple compounds: each duplicate splits one treasury thinner, and peers weight attestations by stake, so under-funded fakes carry near-zero influence. A cheating shell is slashed, and that forfeited value is no smoke plume but a loss the operator must re-fund. Honest agents keep reputation as durable as cedar, while sybil farms burn money faster than any reward can repay.
